releases.title: Product updates in Ate
releases.summary: Read release notes in Settings, then replay a short tour of the changes.

changes.text: Open Release Notes in Settings for readable changes and a replayable What's New tour.

slides.title: Follow what's changing
slides.body: Open Release Notes in Settings to read what changed. Each release keeps its own notes and optional tour.

slides.title: Replay at your own pace
slides.body: A new version opens its tour once, after onboarding. Swipe between pages, or use Back and Next. Done, Close or swiping the sheet away marks this version seen; replay it any time in Settings.

releases.stage: Pilot candidate - 0.1.x technical version line, not stage approval
whatToTest: Read this version's notes and swipe through its two-page tour.
Dismiss the launch tour, relaunch Ate, then replay it from Settings.
howToTest: Open Settings > Release Notes > Product updates in Ate > View What's New.
Swipe between pages, use Back and Next, then Done or Close. The launch tour appears only until this version is dismissed. Saved notes and tour work offline.
